name: The Nestmind
desc:
**The Nestmind** is an NPC that appears in the [A Conscious Intersection](location:a_conscious_intersection). It has an appearance similar to the heads of many Deep Owls within a black void. It is the final step obtaining the **Visionshaper Oath,** being the entity that gives you the oath.

The origin of The Nestmind is unknown, but it is most likely the source of the Deep Owls in the [First Layer](location:first_layer).
